title: Things at the Farm
text: Gus lives on a farm. Cows, pigs, and hens are animals on the farm. Corn and wheat are plants that grow in the fields. A rake and a hoe are tools for the farm. Gus sorts the farm things into three groups. He puts the animals in one group. He puts the plants in another group. He puts the tools in the last group.
comprehension_hint_topics: how Gus sorts the farm things into groups
which things on the farm are animals
